name: make_parenthesis_pairs

name: quote_string

name: TokenList.__str__
reason: Tok.str joins str() of the elements (:143), and UnstructuredSpec proves str(get_unstructured(v)) == v for every v when no encoded word decodes (checked on 53k such inputs on 3.15.2); the MimeParameters.__str__ override is a stated scope limit.

name: BareQuotedString.__str__
reason: Tok.str gives quote_string of the joined elements (:278); QuotingRoundTrip pins it to quote_string(s) and the reparse refutation (bug textlibs-email-quoted-string-reparse) records that it drops the backslash hiding an encoded word.

name: BareQuotedString.value

reason: The `token_type == 'comment'` branch (:297-298) is never reached by any theorem: make_parenthesis_pairs escapes every '(' so the round-trip comments contain no nested comment, and a quote that escaped nested comments like ctext would satisfy QuotingRoundTrip.

name: ValueTerminal.value

name: get_unstructured

name: get_qcontent
